# 1. Setup

```{python}
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

import pandas as pd

from py.config import cfg
```

# 2. Get file paths

```{python}
sqlite_files = sorted(cfg.sqlite_dir.glob("*.sqlite"))

len(sqlite_files), sqlite_files[:5]
```

# 3. Combine tables

```{python}
def quarter_date(year: int, qtr: int) -> pd.Timestamp:
    mapping = {1: "02-15", 2: "05-15", 3: "08-15", 4: "11-15"}
    return pd.Timestamp(f"{year}-{mapping[qtr]}")


def read_quarter_holdings(sqlite_file: Path) -> pd.DataFrame:
    yq = int(sqlite_file.stem)
    year = yq // 10
    qtr = yq % 10

    if qtr not in [1, 2, 3, 4]:
        return pd.DataFrame()

    con = sqlite3.connect(sqlite_file)
    try:
        has_table = con.execute(
            "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='holdings_table_parsed'"
        ).fetchone()
        if has_table is None:
            return pd.DataFrame()

        df = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT * FROM holdings_table_parsed", con)
    finally:
        con.close()

    df["year_qtr"] = yq
    df["year"] = year
    df["qtr"] = qtr
    df["quarter_label"] = f"{year} Q{qtr}"
    df["quarter_date"] = quarter_date(year, qtr)

    return df


all_holdings_list = [read_quarter_holdings(p) for p in sqlite_files]
all_holdings_list = [x for x in all_holdings_list if len(x) > 0]

all_holdings = pd.concat(all_holdings_list, ignore_index=True) if all_holdings_list else pd.DataFrame()

len(all_holdings), all_holdings["year_qtr"].nunique(), all_holdings["filename"].nunique()
```

```{python}
all_holdings.to_parquet(cfg.derived_dir / "all_holdings.parquet", index=False)
```

```{python}
all_holdings.groupby(["year_qtr", "quarter_label"], dropna=False).size().reset_index(name="n")
```
